verdict.rationale: Zoho publishes an official first-party MCP service (Zoho MCP) that explicitly covers Books. The Books features page says users can "Link Zoho Books to your favorite AI agents via MCP," and the MCP page describes connecting LLMs like GPT or Claude to invoicing, payments, expenses and reports. Missing for 10: a Books-specific tool catalog and setup/configuration docs (the hosted service at mcp.zoho.com is sign-in-gated), and independent hands-on corroboration beyond vendor-quoted testimonials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Link Zoho Books to your favorite AI agents via MCP. Create invoices, track payments, and pull reports just by asking without ever leaving your workflow.

It connects LLMs like GPT or Claude to Zoho's APIs, data models, and actions, so agents gain the context, access, and control they need to turn natural instructions into real actions across your business apps.
Generate invoices, track payments, log expenses, and create financial reports.
It enables fully autonomous agents to monitor, reason, and act without human input.
